policyScope: Prospective clarification after the D0-D7 audit; does not retroactively accept any historical candidate

requiredReports.criterion: Report application installer, complete new installation, retained-version overhead and missing-component download separately
Measure final native launch to editable home and target project; exclude test-driver attachment delays
Measure separately with the unchanged 100000-row representative workload
Report full owned process tree, Working Set and Private Commit separately, including Node
Tasks finish with unchanged results; record CPU and memory without cancelling work to lower usage
At least ten consecutive cycles, retained processes and steady memory; keep slow samples and investigate trends

reportingPolicy: Metrics with no numeric threshold are mandatory measurement/completeness requirements, not implicit pass gates. Set any future new numeric target prospectively before comparing a changed candidate.
acceptancePolicy: All numeric gates need the exact native candidate and all mandatory reports. Headless/controller-only samples cannot close native gates. Keep Next topology conditional until those gates pass.
recoveryPolicy: A recoverable draft, successful drain and verified shutdown are prerequisites; faster time cannot compensate for lost work.
